policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="jsonBody" value="@{
    return context.Request.Body.As();
}" />
		
		<set-variable name="userId" value="@{
    var jsonBody = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("jsonBody");
    return jsonBody.ContainsKey("objectId") ? jsonBody["objectId"].ToString() : string.Empty;
}" />
		
		<set-variable name="email" value="@{
    var jsonBody = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("jsonBody");
    return jsonBody.ContainsKey("email") ? jsonBody["email"].ToString() : string.Empty;
}" />
		
		<set-variable name="given_name" value="@{
    var jsonBody = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("jsonBody");
    return jsonBody.ContainsKey("displayName") ? jsonBody["displayName"].ToString() : string.Empty;
}" />
		
		<set-variable name="family_name" value="@{
    var jsonBody = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("jsonBody");
    return jsonBody.ContainsKey("surname") ? jsonBody["surname"].ToString() : string.Empty;
}" />
		
		
			@($"https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/07a0904d-a5d1-4225-9425-271c26419878/resourceGroups/APIM-Testing/providers/Microsoft.ApiManagement/service/apimArekTest2/users/{(string)context.Variables["userId"]}?api-version=2022-08-01")
			PUT
			
				application/json
			
			@{
                return new JObject(
                    new JProperty("properties", new JObject(
                        new JProperty("firstName", context.Variables["given_name"]),
                        new JProperty("lastName", context.Variables["family_name"]),
                        new JProperty("email", context.Variables["email"]),
                        new JProperty("id", $"/subscriptions/07a0904d-a5d1-4225-9425-271c26419878/resourceGroups/APIM-Testing/providers/Microsoft.ApiManagement/service/apimArekTest2/users/{context.Variables["userId"]}"),
                        new JProperty("identities", new JArray(
                            new JObject(
                                new JProperty("provider", "AadB2C"),
                                new JProperty("id", context.Variables["userId"])
                            )
                        ))
                    ))
                ).ToString();
            }
			
		
		
		
		
			<when condition="@{
    var jsonBody = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("jsonBody");
    return jsonBody.ContainsKey("apim/roles") && jsonBody["apim/roles"].Any();
}">
				<set-variable name="groupId" value="@{
    var jsonBody = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("jsonBody");
    return jsonBody["apim/roles"][0].ToString();
}" />
				
					@($"https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/07a0904d-a5d1-4225-9425-271c26419878/resourceGroups/APIM-Testing/providers/Microsoft.ApiManagement/service/apimArekTest2/groups/{(string)context.Variables["groupId"]}/users/{(string)context.Variables["userId"]}?api-version=2022-08-01")
					PUT
					
						application/json
